name: assetcraft
description: assetcraft L2: one binary for the CLI (every verb takes --json) and the MCP stdio server.

tools.name: asset_status
tools.description: Counts, cost of active assets, licence seats, open deadlines, GWG limit.

tools.name: asset_add
tools.description: Register an asset. cost is the AfA base (net if VAT is deductible). GWG is automatic at or below the limit unless gwg=false. Life defaults from the category; cars need at least 8 years.

tools.name: asset_list
tools.description: List assets with book value at the start of this year.

tools.name: asset_show
tools.description: One asset with AfA schedule, postings to buchcraft, maintenance and deadlines.

tools.name: asset_update
tools.description: Change fields; null clears serial/location/holder/warranty_until. cost/in_service/life_years/gwg are frozen once AfA was posted.

tools.name: asset_dispose
tools.description: Retire an asset (sold, scrapped). Returns disposal-year AfA, book value and gain/loss. The asset becomes read-only.

tools.name: asset_afa_schedule
tools.description: Straight-line AfA plan in cents with Halbjahres-AfA and GWG.

tools.name: asset_afa_year
tools.description: AfA for all assets in a year with totals per account. emit=true sends asset.depreciation_due to buchcraft (drafts there, approved by a human); each asset/year is sent once.

tools.name: asset_maintenance_add
tools.description: Log a repair, service or inspection with cost.

tools.name: asset_category_list
tools.description: Categories with default life, minimum life and EKR asset account.

tools.name: asset_category_set
tools.description: Create or change a category (life 1-50, minimum life, EKR account).

tools.name: asset_gwg_limit
tools.description: Show or set the GWG limit (default 1.000,00 since 2023).

tools.name: asset_license_add
tools.description: Register a software licence. Never pass the key itself: key_location says where it is stored.

tools.name: asset_license_list
tools.description: Licences with assigned seats.

tools.name: asset_license_assign
tools.description: Give a person a seat. Refused when full unless force=true.

tools.name: asset_license_unassign
tools.description: Free a seat.

tools.name: asset_license_seats
tools.description: Change the number of seats.

tools.name: asset_license_audit
tools.description: Over-allocated and unused seats, renewals due within 60 days, cost per used seat.

tools.name: asset_deadline_add
tools.description: Track a certificate, domain, insurance, inspection or contract date, optionally tied to an asset.

tools.name: asset_deadline_done
tools.description: Mark a deadline handled.

tools.name: asset_expiries
tools.description: Warranties, licence renewals and deadlines due within N days (default 60), overdue first.

tools.name: asset_label
tools.description: Write a printable SVG label with a QR code (ASSET:<tag>) for an asset.

tools.name: asset_import_csv
tools.description: Import assets from CSV tag;name;category;in_service;cost[;serial;location;holder]. All-or-nothing; dry_run validates only.

tools.name: asset_drain_inbox
tools.description: Record one equipment reminder per hirecraft candidate.hired event. No asset and no cost are invented.

tools.name: asset_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an EMPTY register with a labelled demo inventory, licences and deadlines.
